$media.alt: White crew-neck t-shirt on a white background

data.summary: The everyday crew in crisp white organic cotton.

children.text: Our bestseller: a mid-weight crew-neck with a clean, straight cut that sits right on everyone. Ribbed collar that keeps its shape, taped shoulder seams, no scratchy labels.
Fabric: 100% organic ringspun cotton, 200 gsm, garment-dyed and pre-shrunk. Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Unisex fit — see the size guide for measurements.
